title: Signup before first play
statementMd:
Count listeners whose first play happened within 30 days of signing up.

Expected columns: `quick_starters`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS quick_starters FROM (SELECT l.id FROM listeners l JOIN plays p ON p.listener_id = l.id GROUP BY l.id, l.signup_date HAVING julianday(MIN(substr(p.played_at, 1, 10))) - julianday(l.signup_date) <= 30);
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
